items.prompt: Which of these numbers is a prime number?
hints: A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
Try dividing each number by 3 and 7.
Three of the numbers can be divided by 3 or 7.
items.explanation: 51 = 3 × 17, 57 = 3 × 19 and 91 = 7 × 13. Only 61 has no factors except 1 and itself.

options.why: 51 = 3 × 17, so it has factors other than 1 and itself.
57 = 3 × 19, so it has factors other than 1 and itself.
91 = 7 × 13, so it has factors other than 1 and itself.

items.prompt: Two different prime numbers multiply to make 91. What is their sum?
A square garden has an area of 169 m². Hadi puts a fence all around it. How many metres of fence does he need?
hints: A square number tells you the side length.
Find the number that multiplies by itself to make 169.
items.explanation: 13 × 13 = 169, so each side is 13 m. The fence is 4 × 13 = 52 m.

items.prompt: True or false: The number 29 is a prime number.
items.explanation: 29 is only divisible by 1 and 29. No smaller number except 1 divides it.

items.prompt: True or false: The number 51 is a prime number.
items.explanation: 51 = 3 × 17, so it has more than two factors.

hints: A prime has exactly two factors.
items.explanation: 51 = 3 × 17, so it has more than two factors and is not prime.
